major_claim: The 84-coordinate descriptor admits exact elimination to a 69-state generator with the same finite spectrum.
claim_boundary: Requires the stated algebraic-block and storage-block invertibility conditions; strict HCP-to-Bai degeneration remains open.

major_claim: On the same complete 69-state space and norm, full-state propagated minus frozen-integral log gains are +4.784, +7.217 and +6.402.
claim_boundary: The projected constitutive gain is a separate input-output diagnostic and is not subtracted from the full-state spectral abscissa.

major_claim: Stationary-normal and commuting-normal fixed-leader controls recover propagated/frozen equality, while a switching leader and a mismatched projection fail as predicted.
claim_boundary: Commutation and normality require a common pointwise leader for equality with the integral of the spectral abscissa.

major_claim: Modal condition numbers, eigenvector rotation, nonzero commutators and ordering controls identify active sources of finite-time/frozen non-equivalence.
claim_boundary: These are operator diagnostics rather than unique causal decomposition of the physical specimen.

major_claim: Each of seven input-output selector questions has a stable winner across 11 registered factor-two norms, but different selectors can choose different branches.
claim_boundary: Robustness is conditional on the tested norm family and physical selector question; it is not coordinate or selector invariance.

major_claim: Three independently selected crystal orientations retain positive like-for-like finite-time/frozen discrepancies.
claim_boundary: This is orientation transfer under one loading path, not a full loading-path campaign.

major_claim: The retained onset and terminal basins pass an anchor-assisted convergence and basin-recurrence audit.
claim_boundary: Blind 1024-point Sobol sampling misses the terminal basin; no independent global-optimum certificate is claimed.

major_claim: A four-mode Galerkin replay reproduces the V3 optimized near-onset and terminal singular-vector gains within 0.730% and 0.223% on the matching 513-state map.
claim_boundary: The terminal discarded-RHS Fourier-energy gate fails, so this is not complete grid-resolved nonlinear validation.

major_claim: The constitutive ledger partitions crystal-plastic power into heat and a passive nonthermal remainder consistently with the stated entropy-production inequality.
claim_boundary: The passive remainder is not identified as dislocation Helmholtz free energy and produces no hardening force.

major_claim: The current theory closes finite-time finite-band selection but does not identify a seed-independent material width or areal propagation resistance.
claim_boundary: The selected wavelength is an amplified disturbance period, not a mature shear-band thickness.

major_claim: All seven selectors are independently re-optimized over direction and wavenumber under five norms at onset and terminal horizons; constitutive-response selectors retain interior maxima while 15 unrestricted/mechanical cases hit the upper-k boundary.
claim_boundary: Boundary maxima are classified as high-frequency wave branches and are not converted into localization wavelengths; the search remains anchor-assisted rather than a global certificate.

major_claim: With identical input/output selectors and metric, interval-preserving piecewise-frozen propagators converge toward the time-ordered map; the refinement-16 maximum absolute log-gain error is 0.0982.
claim_boundary: This validates a consistent frozen-generator discretization, not the scalar integral of spectral abscissa.

major_claim: Three added rate/temperature paths preserve an interior terminal constitutive basin, while local parameter sensitivities separate gain controls from selected-scale controls; the matched-rate CP-Ti comparison fails quantitatively.
claim_boundary: The card is a verification seed, not a calibrated specimen predictor; sensitivities are local branch derivatives, not global uncertainty quantification.

major_claim: The mandatory 513-to-1025 density audit closes after the 257-to-513 trigger; the maximum relative log-gain change is 0.666%, and the 1025-state terminal gain is 6.2906e5 at fixed V3 direction and wavenumber.
claim_boundary: The terminal raw gain changes by about 3.3% from 513 to 1025 states; convergence is judged in the declared log-gain objective.

major_claim: The historical raw 16-cell all-mode failure is localized to the even-grid Nyquist coordinate at 1.3515625 microseconds; a matched mode-0--7 calculation that removes only Nyquist completes at both horizons.
manuscript_location: Nonlinear transport Results; Mathematical limits Discussion
claim_boundary: The raw failure is a discrete--continuum Nyquist inconsistency and is not interpreted as a physical short-wave instability.

major_claim: Two-thirds-dealiased 16/32/64-cell replays converge in gain, and independent time-step and integration-format ladders pass; however, the primary terminal discarded nonlinear RHS Fourier-energy fraction is 0.8466.
manuscript_location: Nonlinear transport Methods and Results; Cross-scale Discussion
claim_boundary: The evidence supports resolved finite-band transport, not complete nonlinear harmonic closure, finite-amplitude saturation or a mature material width.

major_claim: The base path is piecewise smooth with four registered switch intervals; bounded branch conventions change terminal gain by at most 0.0617%, and large terminal amplification survives a rank-28 recoverable-energy quotient metric at fixed direction and wavenumber.
manuscript_location: Base-history Methods; Initial-time/branch/metric Results; Mathematical limits Discussion
